name: Under the Flyover
brief: While travelling in Hyderabad, I saw a homeless child squatting beneath a flyover, wearing dirty, torn clothes and deeply absorbed in scrolling reels on a smartphone. The contrast disturbed me. I want to explore that moment through a short, realistic film. The location is beneath a flyover at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed containing soil, with a few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils, not a tent. Use a fictional child. Distinguish the observed moment from creative additions; do not invent a backstory or assert that scrolling caused his poverty. Set the film at night: this is a creative choice, not confirmed as part of the observed incident. The supplied @underpass image is AI-generated, not a photograph of the actual incident; use it only as a mood and night-lighting reference. Its layout is not approved for video and does not change the setting above. The final location reference will be chosen before any video generation.

direction.palette: night: warm sodium streetlight glancing off concrete pillars and asphalt, deep shadow under the flyover, cool blue-black sky
direction.notes: no music; no on-screen text or logos

decisions: The child is fictional and must not resemble any identifiable real child.
Keep the observed moment separate from creative additions; no invented backstory.
Do not suggest that scrolling, or the phone, caused his poverty.
Location: beneath a flyover at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed of soil with a few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils; not a tent.
Night is a creative choice; it is not confirmed as part of the observed incident.

The supplied @underpass image (AI-generated, not a photo of the incident) is a mood and night-lighting reference only. Its layout (tarp shelter, concrete kerb instead of a soil bed, extra belongings, readable signs, no U-turn) is NOT approved for video; this mismatch is unresolved. Keep the setting from the brief.
The final location reference will be chosen before any video generation.
The first video uses only @boy and @underpass; the smartphone is described in the action (a separate phone asset is deferred).
